name_input: Artificial Limbs Manufacturing Corporation of India (ALIMCO)
export_evidence: ImportKey page for ARTIFICIAL LIMBS MANUFACTURING CORPORATION OF INDIA (G.T. Road, Kanpur-209217) shows only INBOUND rows, e.g. "2022-03-11 | JIANGSU INTCO MEDICAL PRODUCTS CO.,LTD | ARTIFICIAL LIMBS MANUFACTURING CORPORATION OF INDIA | WHEELCHAIR AND PARTS | Shanghai, China | Calcutta, India | 960000 | SHSO3B11C200" — 5 rows seen, all imports (China→India), zero export rows, zero outbound B/L. Source counter: ImportKey lists "Total Shipments 7" for the supplier Jiangsu Intco; no export shipment count is displayed for ALIMCO at all.
domestic_evidence: No verifiable domestic-supply record retrieved. alimco.in timed out on two attempts (https://www.alimco.in/ and /index.aspx); GeM/CPPP tender pages not reachable via available search (DuckDuckGo backend returned 'Connection refused'; Bing returned irrelevant results). GST turnover band, contract numbers and annual-report revenue split: null — not public in sources reachable here.
note: ALIMCO is a Government of India CPSE (Dept. of Empowerment of PwD) at G.T. Road, Kanpur — the state_claimed 'Karnataka' is inconsistent with the registered address seen in trade data (Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh); flag for correction. Declared HS 660200/902110/902139 are plausible for orthotics/prosthetics, but the only customs rows actually observed are imports of wheelchairs under HS 960000 (wheelchairs), not the declared codes — HS should be corrected to the factual mix. No export shipment with date/destination/B-L was found; per Rule 5 this is recorded as 'следов экспортных отгрузок не найдено', not as a soft acceptance. Domestic supply is not confirmed either — no GST band, GeM/CPPP order or contract could be read, so domestic_status = unknown rather than confirmed. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in reachable sources). Traders/CPSE status is not a rejection ground; no liquidation/bankruptcy evidence found.
